_about: Pass/fail thresholds for stage 3, written 2026-11-28 before run.py was first executed. Each check compares one key of results/<id>.json 'measured' with max (value <= x), min (value >= x) or equals. Thresholds come from error budgets stated under 'basis', not from runs. They are not loosened to make a task pass; a changed threshold keeps its old value and the reason under 'changes'. Budget terms used below: joint friction 0.2 N m / kp 150 = 1.3 mrad per joint, about 0.5 mm at the foot; soft foot contact, the sphere centre sinks about 13 mm at 37 N (modules/MODULE_SPEC.md), a few mm more or less as the load per foot changes; the robot stands on the floor with no support in every task.

3.01.title: Resting configuration
3.01.basis: q_rest = (0, 1.36, -2.65) rad per leg, computed: knee 0.07 rad inside its fold limit, thigh angle that puts the foot centre 0.106 m below the hip, level with the bottom of the trunk's chin sphere (0.107 m). Rest must cost little torque (20 % of the limit) and be static.

3.02.title: Stand up
3.02.basis: predicted standing base height = kinematic height of Q_STAND (0.2664 m above the foot centres) + foot centre height 0.009 m from MODULE_SPEC; 5 mm covers the contact sinkage spread and the joint friction band

3.03.title: Hold standing
3.03.basis: 10 s hold under the posture controller; deviations measured from the height and attitude 0.5 s after the hold starts

3.04.title: Crouch
3.04.basis: minimum-jerk height change of 0.095 m in 1.5 s, peak vertical acceleration 0.55 m/s^2; the force feed-forward is static, so the uncompensated inertial force (15.2 kg x 0.55 = 8.4 N) is carried by the PD, about 1 to 2 mm. Note added after the run, thresholds unchanged: the peak acceleration is 5.77 x 0.095 / 1.5^2 = 0.24 m/s^2 (3.7 N), the 0.55 above was an arithmetic slip

3.05.title: Raise the body
3.05.basis: three raised heights; a request beyond the leg reach (rho_max = 0.390 m) must be rejected by the IK before any motion

3.06.title: Lower the body
3.06.basis: trunk clearance predicted from the box and chin-sphere geometry and the commanded pose; guard rejects poses with predicted clearance below 0.02 m

3.07.title: Pitch the body
3.07.basis: pitch steps to +-10 deg and a +-8 deg, 0.5 Hz sine with feet fixed; a 3 mm sinkage difference between front and rear feet (0.39 m apart) is 0.44 deg

3.08.title: Roll the body
3.08.basis: roll steps to +-10 deg and a +-8 deg, 0.5 Hz sine; feet 0.284 m apart laterally, so 3 mm sinkage difference is 0.6 deg; same threshold as pitch

3.09.title: Shift the centre of mass
3.09.basis: eight CoM targets 40 mm from the stance centre; static equilibrium puts the centre of pressure on the CoM projection; the guard rejects targets with predicted margin below 0.02 m

3.10.title: Lift one foot on three legs
3.10.basis: CoM shifted to 0.04 m inside the FR-RL-RR triangle, FL unloaded over 0.5 s then lifted 0.06 m; with three feet the vertical forces are statically determinate, the 5 N allows for tangential forces acting 0.27 m above the contacts

3.11.title: Place the lifted foot
3.11.basis: FL placed 0.06 m forward of its start; error between the target and the MuJoCo contact point, horizontal

3.12.title: Return to the original posture
3.12.basis: three full cycles (step FL out 0.06 m, step it back, CoM and body back to nominal); errors against the pose before the first cycle
